checkedDeclarations.name: Finset.sum_range_succ_mul_sum_range_succ
checkedDeclarations.sourceSnippet:
lemma sum_range_succ_mul_sum_range_succ (m n : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R) :
    (∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), f i) * ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), g i =
      (∑ i ∈ range m, f i) * ∑ i ∈ range n, g i +
        f m * ∑ i ∈ range n, g i + (∑ i ∈ range m, f i) * g n + f m * g n := by

checkedDeclarations.name: Finset.sum_smul_sum
checkedDeclarations.sourceSnippet:
lemma Finset.sum_smul_sum (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) {f : α → R} {g : β → M} :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) • ∑ j ∈ t, g j = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, f i • g j := by
  simp_rw [sum_smul, ← smul_sum]

  [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid.{u_4} M] [inst_2 : Module.{u_3, u_4} R M] (s : Finset.{u_1} α) (t : Finset.{u_2} β)
  {f : α → R} {g : β → M},
  Eq.{u_4 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{u_3, u_4, u_4} (∑ i ∈ s, f i) (∑ j ∈ t, g j))

checkedDeclarations.name: Finset.sum_nat_mod
checkedDeclarations.sourceSnippet:
theorem sum_nat_mod (s : Finset ι) (n : ℕ) (f : ι → ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) % n = (∑ i ∈ s, f i % n) % n :=
  (Multiset.sum_nat_mod _ _).trans <| by rw [Finset.sum, Multiset.map_map]; rfl

checkedDeclarations.name: Finset.sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_perm
checkedDeclarations.sourceSnippet:
theorem sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_perm (hσ : σ.IsCycleOn s) (f g : ι → α) :
    ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) * ∑ i ∈ s, g i) = ∑ k ∈ range #s, ∑ i ∈ s, f i * g ((σ ^ k) i) :=
  sum_smul_sum_eq_sum_perm hσ f g
checkedDeclarations.signature:
@Finset.sum_mul_sum_eq_sum_perm.{u_1,
    u_2} : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring.{u_2} α] {s : Finset.{u_1} ι} {σ : Equiv.Perm.{u_1 + 1} ι},
  Equiv.Perm.IsCycleOn.{u_1} σ ↑s →
    ∀ (f g : ι → α),
      Eq.{u_2 + 1} (HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} (∑ i ∈ s, f i) (∑ i ∈ s, g i))
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Finset.card.{u_1} s),
          ∑ i ∈ s, HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} (f i) (g ((HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} σ k) i)))

theorem abs_sum_le_sum_abs {G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G]
    (f : ι → G) (s : Finset ι) :
    |∑ i ∈ s, f i| ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, |f i| := le_sum_of_subadditive _ abs_zero.le abs_add_le s f
